models.label: Kling 4.0 Image to Video
models.description: Kling 4.0 animates a starting image into a 3 to 30-second video at 720p or 1080p
models.notes: Capabilities read from fal's own queue schema. The frame follows the image.

price.basis: fal's pricing API lists $0.157 per second, which for video is the cheapest resolution tier. Not billed until a person verifies the per-resolution figures.
